title: Data Equivalence for Even Orthogonal Groups
body_html:
Data Equivalence for Even Orthogonal Groups

Let \(\Sigma\) and \(\Sigma'\) be supercuspidal data for \(G=O(V)\), with \(V\) even-dimensional. Then \[ \pi_\Sigma\simeq\pi_{\Sigma'} \] if and only if \(\Sigma\) and \(\Sigma'\) are equivalent in the sense of supercuspidal_theta.supercuspidal_datum_equivalence.
proof_html:
If the parahoric \(G_x^0\) lies in \(SO(V)\), the restriction of \(\pi_\Sigma\) to \(SO(V)\) is a sum of compact inductions attached to the connected datum and its conjugate by an element of \(O(V)\setminus SO(V)\). The connected Hakim-Murnaghan theorem then gives \(G\)-conjugacy of the data.

If \(G_x^0\) meets the nonidentity component, the proof splits according to Clifford theory. When the restriction of \(\rho\) to the connected parahoric is reducible, the connected argument plus the index-two analysis gives the same equivalence condition. When the restriction is irreducible, both \(\rho\) and \(\rho'\) occur in the multiplicity space supercuspidal_theta.ordinary_kappa_multiplicity_space, and that multiplicity space has a single irreducible constituent; hence \(\rho\simeq\rho'\) after aligning \(x,\Gamma,\phi\).
